messages:
sam: Pager fired 1802345678 — p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions. Getting multiple customer reports of timeouts. system: Incident created (INC-2026-107).
liz: Oncall jumping in. Is this isolated to a model or global?
mike: From quick look: p95 stable, p99 for Mistral-Chat up ~800ms -> 2.4s over last 3m. Other models OK.
rafael: I see increases in queue length on the Mistral pool. Metrics: worker_cpu ~92%, queue_wait 400ms.
anya: @liz are there recent deploys? (typing)
liz: No deploy in last 30m. Autoscaler did trigger a couple of times but couldn't catch up.
incident-bot: @sam @liz @mike Paging oncall rotation: tanya now assigned.
tanya: I'm on. Root cause hypothesis: transient load spike + batching behavior causing head-of-line delays on long-seq requests.
sam: Mitigation 1: Add temporary alert squelch for the repeated p99 flaps to avoid alert storm while we triage. Propose 10 min suppression on channel alerts, keep pager for sustained >10m. Thoughts?
mike: +1 to squelch but keep high-severity pager if error rate > 1% or p99 > 3s for 5m.
liz: Agreed. Also we should route heavy seq requests to the lower-concurrency pathway (per-route split) — can we flip routing policy to favor Mistral-XL-lt variant?
rafael: I can push a routing policy change: route /v1/chat/completions?model=mistral-chat&seq>1024 to mistral-chat-lite fallback. That should reduce tail latency.
tanya: Do it. Also throttling at ingress: limit concurrent per-tenant to 6 for now.
sam: Executing squelch: `./ops/alerting suppress --rule latency_p99_chat --duration 10m --reason "incident mitigation"` (deployed).
incident-bot: Alert suppression applied by sam for 10m.
mike: Rafael pushed the routing change and I validated a dry run. Traffic shift ~18% off hot pool -> preliminary p99 drop to ~1.1s.
liz: Nice. I'm going to create a transient dashboard panel for per-model p95/p99 and queue_wait so we can watch this split live. Patch: `dashboards/incidents/mistral-routing-live` created.
rafael: Observability note: tagging requests with routing_variant so we can slice later during RCA.
tanya: Customer impact: initial spike caused ~4 customers to see >2s latencies, one reported client-side timeouts. Raised support ticket C-3321.
sam: Hand-off plan: I'll be primary for next 30m, tanya takes 30-90m and then normal oncall. We'll update support.
mike: Action items post-incident: 1) revisit p99 thresholds per-model (current global rule is too coarse). 2) add per-route dynamic thresholds based on seq distribution. 3) implement automated temporary routing fallback when p99 breaches for model pool.
liz: Also recommend adding a noise-reduction rule: only fire pager if p99 > 2s AND error_rate > 0.2% OR sustained for 5m.
rafael: I'll open an infra ticket to add `routing-fallback` as a configurable policy in the console.
tanya: For now, monitoring looks stable, p99 trending down to 900ms. I'll watch and escalate if it creeps.
sam: Thanks team. After stabilization, let's meet for a 30-min debrief and set tasks for alert tuning + dashboards. I'll update the incident doc and link to dashboards + support ticket. :thumbsup:
